user.title: INSIIDA quick setup
user.description:
Found these INSIIDA devices: {devices}.

Each device gets signal strength, network role, reboot count and last boot sensors.
To set up scene keys, press "Configure" on this integration after adding it.

abort.matter_not_ready: Matter is not running. Add the Matter integration and your INSIIDA devices first.
abort.no_devices: No INSIIDA devices in Matter yet. Add your switch or sensor to Home Assistant first.
abort.single_instance_allowed: INSIIDA is already added. Press "Configure" on it to change settings.

init.title: Scene keys
init.description: Choose a scene key. Only switches that were detached on the switch before being added to HA are listed.

key.title: What should {key} do
key.description:
Leave unused presses empty. Leaving everything empty removes this key's setup.
A single press acts about half a second late while the switch checks for a double press.
If a blueprint or automation already uses this key, both will run.

data_description.single_lights: With several lights: if any is on, all turn off; if all are off, all turn on.

abort.no_scene_keys: No scene keys found. Detach the key on the switch first, then add the switch to HA. If it is already added, delete it in HA, detach, and add it again.
